svg.text: Zipp is a URL shortener built as a system design exercise, with

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Charter, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: load-test numbers to back it up.

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Charter, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Charter, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: very redirect is served from a Redis cache, with negative caching for

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Charter, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: codes that don't exist, so the hot path never touches MongoDB. Short

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Charter, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: codes are generated without a “does it exist?” lookup, and click

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Charter, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: analytics flow through Redis Streams instead of the request. Against

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Charter, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: MongoDB alone, the same API process managed 6,444 requests a second.
